commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a new ScriptableObject (or other UnityEngine.Object) asset of the given type at a path under the authoring root.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Asset path relative to the authoring root, including extension (e.g. Data/Config.asset or Materials/Wall.mat). The Assets/ prefix is optional.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Fully-qualified or short type name to instantiate (e.g. UnityEngine.Material, MyGame.GameConfig). Must derive from UnityEngine.Object and be creatable.

parameters.name: shader
parameters.description: Material-only (ignored otherwise): shader name to assign (e.g. Standard, "Universal Render Pipeline/Lit"). When omitted, defaults to "Universal Render Pipeline/Lit" if a Scriptable Render Pipeline is active, otherwise the built-in "Standard" shader (falling back to "Standard" if URP/Lit is unavailable).

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Required (true) only when overwriting an existing asset at the path. Ignored when the path is empty.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, validate inputs and report what would be created without writing anything.

commands.name: set_profile
commands.description: Edit an existing Build Profile's scene list and scripting defines (Unity 6 only). Every setting is optional; only the ones supplied change. The platform cannot be changed here: recreate the profile with build create_profile and confirm=true. Returns feature_unavailable on earlier versions.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the profile to edit (see build list_profiles).

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: Folder holding the profile. Only needed when several profiles share the name.

parameters.name: overrideGlobalScenes
parameters.description: Build with the profile's own scene list instead of the global Build Settings list. Omit to leave unchanged.

parameters.name: scenes
parameters.description: Scene asset paths in build order, replacing the profile's scene list; all are enabled. An empty list clears it. Omit to leave unchanged.

parameters.name: scriptingDefines
parameters.description: Scripting define symbols replacing the profile's own. An empty list clears them. Omit to leave unchanged.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Accepted for parity; not required, since the edit is undoable.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Validate the changes and report what would change, without writing anything.

commands.name: get_fields
commands.description: Read serialized fields of a component/asset. Returns each top-level field's name, type and value (object references are returned as re-usable handles). Pass 'field' to read a single SerializedProperty path. Pass format='value' to return just the value(s) — a token-efficient read for scalars.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Reference to the component or asset to read (globalId/path/guid/instanceId/hierarchyPath). May be a GameObject when 'component' is given.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Optional single SerializedProperty path to read (e.g. 'speed' or 'items.Array.data[0]'). Omit to read all top-level fields.

parameters.name: component
parameters.description: Component type name on the target GameObject (e.g. 'Rigidbody'). Use when 'target' is a GameObject; omit when 'target' is already a component handle.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output shape. Omit (default) for a full descriptor per field {name,path,propertyType,isArray,arrayLength,value}; 'value' returns just the value(s): the raw value for a single 'field', or a {name: value} map for all fields.

commands.name: batch
commands.description: Run multiple registered commands in one transactional request. Later ops can reference earlier results with "$<id-or-index>.<jsonPath>" (e.g. "$0.instanceId"; "$$" escapes a literal '$'). transactional=true (default) groups every op into one Undo step and reverts all applied ops if any op fails; commands that mutate outside the Undo system (asset/file/settings writes) are rejected unless transactional=false. on_error=abort|continue (continue forces transactional=false); dry_run validates without mutating; timeout (seconds, default 60) bounds execution — when it is about to run out the remaining ops are skipped and a transactional batch rolls back (submit long batches with "job": true). Excludes build run, build.target switch, the package commands, editor.playmode start/stop/pause, script recompile, script eval, script eval_file, script run, editor invoke_menu, scene open/scene create, async commands (test run/test list), runtime-only commands, and nested job batch.

parameters.name: operations
parameters.description: Ordered operations to run; each is { id?, command, params }, with command written as "<group> <name>" (e.g. "gameobject create"). Max 200.

parameters.name: transactional
parameters.description: Group all ops into one Undo step and revert every applied op if any op fails. Default true. Forced false when on_error=continue. Rejects commands whose mutations Undo cannot revert (asset/file/settings writes).

parameters.name: on_error
parameters.description: abort (default): stop at the first failing op. continue: run every op, collecting per-op errors (forces transactional=false).

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Validate command names, parameters, reference topology and excluded commands without mutating anything.

parameters.name: result_fields
parameters.description: Optional per-op result projection: map of op id-or-index -> array of result field paths to keep (context economy).

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Timeout for the whole batch in seconds (default 60). Checked before each op after the first; when it is about to run out the remaining ops are skipped and a transactional batch rolls back. Use "job": true for long batches.

schema.title: job batch
schema.description: Run multiple registered commands in one transactional request. Later ops can reference earlier results with "$<id-or-index>.<jsonPath>" (e.g. "$0.instanceId"; "$$" escapes a literal '$'). transactional=true (default) groups every op into one Undo step and reverts all applied ops if any op fails; commands that mutate outside the Undo system (asset/file/settings writes) are rejected unless transactional=false. on_error=abort|continue (continue forces transactional=false); dry_run validates without mutating; timeout (seconds, default 60) bounds execution — when it is about to run out the remaining ops are skipped and a transactional batch rolls back (submit long batches with "job": true). Excludes build run, build.target switch, the package commands, editor.playmode start/stop/pause, script recompile, script eval, script eval_file, script run, editor invoke_menu, scene open/scene create, async commands (test run/test list), runtime-only commands, and nested job batch.

id.description: Optional id for referencing this op's result from a later op ("$<id>.<field>"). Unique within the batch; must match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$ (not purely numeric, no dots).

command.description: The command to run, written as "<group> <name>" (e.g. "gameobject create").

params.description: Parameters for the command. String values may reference a prior op's result: "$<id-or-index>.<jsonPath>".

operations.description: Ordered operations to run; each is { id?, command, params }, with command written as "<group> <name>" (e.g. "gameobject create"). Max 200.

transactional.description: Group all ops into one Undo step and revert every applied op if any op fails. Default true. Forced false when on_error=continue. Rejects commands whose mutations Undo cannot revert (asset/file/settings writes).

on_error.description: abort (default): stop at the first failing op. continue: run every op, collecting per-op errors (forces transactional=false).

dry_run.description: Validate command names, parameters, reference topology and excluded commands without mutating anything.

result_fields.description: Optional per-op result projection: map of op id-or-index -> array of result field paths to keep (context economy).

timeout.description: Timeout for the whole batch in seconds (default 60). Checked before each op after the first; when it is about to run out the remaining ops are skipped and a transactional batch rolls back. Use "job": true for long batches.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Compile a project C# file in memory (no domain reload) and execute a named static entry point. The builder-pattern path for bulk construction. Still arbitrary code execution — shares script eval's capability gate.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Path to a .cs file to compile. Relative paths resolve against the PROJECT ROOT (the parent of Assets/), not the process working directory. May live OUTSIDE Assets/ (e.g. AgentScripts/) so writing it never triggers an asset import or domain reload.

parameters.name: entry
parameters.description: Entry point as Namespace.Type.Method (or Type.Method, or a bare Method name). Default: the single public static method if unambiguous, else a method named Main. Static methods only in v1. Ephemeral mode only (rejected with mode=hotpatch, which never invokes an entry point).

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: JSON array of arguments passed to the entry point, coerced to its parameter types: primitives, enum names, string[], and a string/object handle (ObjectRef) for UnityEngine.Object parameters. Ephemeral mode only (rejected with mode=hotpatch).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: ephemeral (default): compile to an in-memory assembly, run the entry, discard. hotpatch: apply [MethodReload] method replacements to already-loaded types (script.methodreload reload semantics).

parameters.name: references
parameters.description: Extra assembly name prefixes to reference beyond the auto-resolved set. In the Editor all loaded assemblies are already referenced, so this is effectively a no-op there. Ephemeral mode only; not applied by hotpatch (which delegates to script.methodreload reload's own compile).

parameters.name: defines
parameters.description: Extra scripting define symbols APPENDED to the project's active editor defines (UNITY_EDITOR etc. are already set) for the compilation's #if directives. Ephemeral mode only; not applied by hotpatch.

parameters.name: pdb
parameters.description: Emit a portable PDB mapped to the source file so breakpoints bind and exception stack traces map to file:line. Compiles unoptimized.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Timeout in seconds. Bounds the whole run, including how long an async entry point's Task is awaited (on expiry the task keeps running detached).

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Compile only: return diagnostics; the emitted assembly is NOT loaded into the domain and nothing executes. Ephemeral mode only (rejected with mode=hotpatch, which would apply live method replacements).

player.description: Target connected player id; -1 = broadcast to all connected players

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show current method reload registry status and statistics

schema.title: script.methodreload status
schema.description: Show current method reload registry status and statistics

commands.name: get
commands.description: Read PlayerSettings (company/product/version, scripting backend, API level).

schema.title: settings.player get
schema.description: Read PlayerSettings (company/product/version, scripting backend, API level).

commands.name: set
commands.description: Change PlayerSettings. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z. Scripting backend / API level changes trigger a domain reload.

parameters.name: settings
parameters.description: Fields to change; omitted fields are left unchanged.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Apply the change. Without it the call is refused.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Preview the change without applying it.

schema.title: settings.player set
schema.description: Change PlayerSettings. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z. Scripting backend / API level changes trigger a domain reload.

scriptingBackend.description: Scripting backend (e.g. Mono2x, IL2CPP). Triggers a domain reload.

apiCompatibilityLevel.description: API compatibility level (e.g. NET_Standard_2_0, NET_Unity_4_8). Triggers a domain reload.

settings.description: Fields to change; omitted fields are left unchanged.

confirm.description: Apply the change. Without it the call is refused.

dry_run.description: Preview the change without applying it.
